channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Darius Garland | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Darius Garland from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Max Strus on Darius Garland
item.description:
Max Strus on Darius Garland being in a situation where he is maybe the Clippers leader:

“No maybes about it. That’s for sure. There is gonna be a lot riding on DG’s shoulders but we’re all here to support him and push him through that. He’s capable of it. He’s a hell of basketball player… I’m excited to see him fully healthy and get us a full look at DG this season.”

Max Strus on Darius Garland, Sep 29, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brook Lopez on Darius Garland
item.description:
Brook Lopez, on Darius Garland’s deep 3s opening up the offense:

“He obviously draws so much attention and makes the floor so big and makes great decisions with that power that it makes it easy for us to, obviously, play off that.”

Brook Lopez on Darius Garland, Mar 26, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Darius Garland
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard, on Darius Garland’s deep 3s opening up the offense:

“It just extends the defense out further, creating new gaps, easier to drive to the basket when they’re extended and, obviously, it’s great for him and great for the scoreboard.”

Kawhi Leonard on Darius Garland, Mar 26, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Tyronn Lue, on Clippers’ half-court success with Kawhi Leonard and Darius Garland:

“I think it comes with great responsibility when you’re Darius and Kawhi. You have to be aggressive scoring ... but you also have to make your teammates better. They’ve been able to do that.”

Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland, Kawhi Leonard, Mar 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Darius Garland
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on Darius Garland:

“Number one, just competitive nature… We’re gonna be looking at him to get us involved, get him some shots, pushing the pace in transition for us, and just getting everybody involved and calling sets so we’re not stagnant at times. I think he’s able to do that. He’s an All-Star player. I’m just looking forward to playing more basketball with him.”

Kawhi Leonard on Darius Garland, Mar 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland
item.description:
Ty Lue on Darius Garland's debut tonight:

“I'm just, you know, happy he's going to be on the floor... You know, be aggressive, just try to get his wind and try to get his timing down. Just play free and so I just want to get him out on the floor and just kind of see what we can do, how we can tweak certain things. I’m just excited to get him on the floor.”

Tyronn Lue on Darius Garland, Mar 2, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Darius Garland
item.description:
Nicolas Batum on Darius Garland:

“We can’t wait. We’re doing good, we’ve shown some good stuff over the last two. It’s also been tough for us. But that kinda showed us we need him. We can’t wait to have him back on the court with us.”

Nicolas Batum on Darius Garland, Feb 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Darius Garland
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on Darius Garland:

“Very talented guard. 26, probably still got a bright side to him. I don’t think we’ve seen the best of him yet…Pace. A guy who knows how to pass the ball. Can shoot threes, got amazing touch. Competitor. I think that’s what he’s gonna bring to our table.”

Kawhi Leonard on Darius Garland, Feb 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Kyrie Irving, Darius Garland
item.description:
Justin Russo:Tyronn Lue, on using Darius Garland like Kyrie Irving:

“That’s what I told him. He went back and watched a whole bunch of film from those days. We’re gonna put the ball in his hands, he’s got to be able to make plays for himself and his teammates. He has the ability to do that.”

Tyronn Lue on Kyrie Irving, Darius Garland, Feb 5, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Cam Christie on Darius Garland
item.description:
Cam Christie, on new Clipper Darius Garland:

“I’m excited to get to know him more and get him acclimated to the system and be able to watch him grow. Super excited to see him play in our system because I think he brings a lot of stuff that we can use.”

Cam Christie on Darius Garland, Feb 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: John Wall on Donovan Mitchell, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Evan Mobley
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: John Wall on the Cavs:

“I think they gotta make a big change. Donovan Mitchell, Darius Garland are just not getting along in that backcourtand I think with Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley they're just too soft”

John Wall on Donovan Mitchell, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Evan Mobley, Dec 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rich Paul on Jayson Tatum, Darius Garland, Tyrese Maxey, Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Rich Paul:

“So no, I don't represent Cade Cunningham — but I do represent Cade Cunningham, right? I don’t represent someone else — I represent Tyrese Maxey. I represent Darius Garland. I represent De’Aaron Fox. I represent — you know, the list goes on and on and on — as their actual agent. But when you talk about other people — the Ja Morants, the Jayson Tatums, and these guys — I don't technically represent those guys. But what I do matters for those guys, even without representing them.”

Rich Paul on Jayson Tatum, Darius Garland, Tyrese Maxey, Cade Cunningham, Dec 6, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Max Strus, Darius Garland
item.description:
Mitchell said.

“I think now we’re having to gut some wins out, having to have tough losses, seeing different coverages, seeing teams guard you differently, and this is all without DG [Garland] and Max [Strus]. So, when we get them back, continue to take those steps.“Obviously, you want to go 15-0, right. But for myself and for us as a team I’m OK here because this is showing us so many different lessons within the first 15, 16 games.”

Donovan Mitchell on Max Strus, Darius Garland, Nov 25, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Kyle Anderson on Darius Garland
item.description:
In the aftermath of Cleveland’s four-game sweep over Miami in the first round of the 2025 NBA playoffs, Heat reserve Kyle Anderson was asked what changed in the final two games — back-to-back Cavaliers blowouts by a combined 92 points, making it the most lopsided playoff series in history.

“You want my honest answer? I don’t mean to throw shots at anybody. ...But they look like a better team without Garland on the floor,”

Kyle Anderson on Darius Garland, May 3, 2025. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Koby Altman on Darius Garland
item.description:
“It was our job to help him with the staff that was going to empower him again. But never once did Darius ever ask out, never once did Darius have an issue with Donovan, and never once did he have an issue with the organization.”

Koby Altman on Darius Garland, Feb 28, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Darius Garland
item.description:
Atkinson said last week, comparing Garland to Curry.

“He (Garland) can break — you know Steph can break anybody down. When you have elite shooting and you have the dribble-move game or whatever, the creation part — that’s unique. And you can shoot the off-the-dribble 3. There’s very, very few guys in this league, there’s two, three of them in the league. I just think he’s unique. “I keep talking about his growth, much like Steph was, (Garland) just keep getting stronger,”

Kenny Atkinson on Darius Garland, Jan 21, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell, Darius Garland
item.description:
“A lot of it is the bench. We kind of know the main guys, Donovan and Darius, but we have Ty and Evan making 3s tonight. What I do like — a big part of it is we are generating great shots. Shot quality, I think we are 1 or 2 in the league.”

Kenny Atkinson on Donovan Mitchell, Darius Garland, Dec 6, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Darius Garland, Evan Mobley
item.description:
Mitchell told cleveland.com on Saturday.

“I’m on social media so I see it. You hear it. We all do. It’s the easy thing to point to. It’s easy to fall into that. We live in this world that always likes to create controversy. We just had a really good stretch. We just went on a run. But that speaks to our team and our group. At the end of the day, we are a complete team. That’s more of the reason for our recent success. That’s a better way to explain this situation. It’s not about who is not playing. We won 51 games with Darius and Ev [Evan Mobley] last year. We wouldn’t be here without them. We need those guys.”

Donovan Mitchell on Darius Garland, Evan Mobley, Feb 4, 2024. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Darius Garland
item.description:
#Cavs J.B. Bickerstaff on Darius Garland closing games while still being on a minute restriction:

“Trying to avoid long spells of him having to sit out & then work himself back in. We're working on figuring out how to just save 3 minutes. I think we'll see it moving forward”

JB Bickerstaff on Darius Garland, Feb 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Jeff Teague on De'Aaron Fox, Darius Garland
item.description:
“[De'Aaron Fox] and Darius Garland retired me… Fox made me wanna go to the bench… He was running so fast one game, he just kept running at me ... my knees still suffering from them change of directions. He was running so fast I'm like, 'What did I do to him?'”

Jeff Teague on De'Aaron Fox, Darius Garland, Aug 9, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Cavs J.B. Bickerstaff on Darius Garland
item.description:
Kelsey Russo:#Cavs J.B. Bickerstaff on Darius Garland:

“He's doing better. There's swelling, so got to wait until the swelling goes down. When you hold his eye open, he can see. So that's obviously a good thing. But it's just going to take time, and we just have to wait and see.”

Cavs J.B. Bickerstaff on Darius Garland, Oct 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @kelseyyrusso.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Darius Garland
item.description:
Serena Winters:Donovan Mitchell on working out with Darius Garland:

“I consider myself a pretty good shooter, but he’s right there if not better... He makes me have to raise my level in a workout.”

Donovan Mitchell on Darius Garland, Sep 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: LeBron James on Kevin Love, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland
item.description:
“I think big fella (Allen), that acquisition was amazing for them to make that trade. Obviously Darius Garland is a big-time player. And I think the role that Kevin (Love) is playing right now has kind of uplifted those young guys, seeing a veteran that could sacrifice, a champion that’s won a championship, all the things that he’s done, to come off the bench and play this role. I am not surprised by anything that they’re doing right now.”

LeBron James on Kevin Love, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Feb 19, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Rajon Rondo on Darius Garland
item.description:
Serena Winters:Rajon Rondo on @Darius Garland:

“Definitely a hell of a talent… score, shoot pass, hell of a playmaker & most importantly what I like is he competes on both ends of the floor& if you have that on the court, I’m willing to go to war any night.”

Rajon Rondo on Darius Garland, Jan 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Brad Daugherty on Collin Sexton, Darius Garland
item.description:
When Daugherty came back to the Cleveland area this past season and mingled with the team, he had opportunities to speak with Cavs players both young and old.

“It’s really funny because Collin Sexton is an excellent young man, and Darius Garland and these guys look at you and they know who you are, but they kind of don’t because they (are too young),”

Brad Daugherty on Collin Sexton, Darius Garland, Sep 3, 2020. Source: The Athletic.
